title: Ddn, F420, and nitroimidazoles
dek: Pretomanid and delamanid are prodrugs. Ddn (deazaflavin-dependent nitroreductase) plus the F420 biosynthetic genes (fbiA/B/C/D, fgd1) activate them. Loss-of-function is the resistance grammar.
story: Delamanid and pretomanid (Pa-824) are bicyclic nitroimidazoles. They require reduction by Ddn using the cofactor F420-H2. Mutations that wreck ddn, fgd1, or F420 biosynthesis (fbiA, fbiB, fbiC, fbiD) prevent activation. That is a loss-of-function catalogue, more like pncA than like rpoB’s missense hotspot.

Cross-resistance between DLM and Pa is expected when the shared activation path is broken, but it is not always complete — some alleles shift one MIC more than the other. Do not assume DLM rescues a ddn knockout.

WHO catalogue 2nd ed expanded DLM-associated variants substantially; Pa still has thinner phenotype pairing. Humility is part of the grade. A WT panel is a prior, not a promise, especially after prior nitroimidazole exposure.
deep: Full-gene ddn and fbi genes, not a codon-306-style hotspot. Frameshifts count.
Lineage SNPs in fbi genes exist. Grade, don’t regex.
If BPaLM is being used at scale, this locus will stop being rare. Surveillance should watch ddn the way it watched rpoB in the 1990s.
Metronidazole is a different nitroimidazole with poor Mtb activity in oxic lesions; do not file it as Pa.

visual.caption: Nitroimidazole prodrugs funnel through F420-H2 and Ddn. Breaking any step of cofactor synthesis or the reductase blocks both DLM and Pa more often than not.

example.title: fbiC frameshift on BPaLM month 3
example.setup: Sputum tNGS at month 3: new fbiC frameshift AF 0.40. Baseline ddn/fbi WT. Still culture-positive.

steps.title: Pa is no longer a counting drug
steps.body: Activation loss is the nitroimidazole grammar. This is emerging Pa/DLM resistance until MIC says otherwise.

steps.title: Do not swap in DLM as a rescue
steps.body: Shared F420 path. Adding DLM is not a new mechanism.

steps.title: Rebuild
steps.body: You are leaving BPaLM. Need remaining Group A/B integrity (BDQ, LZD, FQ) and a longer or alternative construct.

example.takeaway: Nitroimidazole resistance is an activation-network failure, often cross-class.
